items.source: Customizers are guaranteed to be applied before any Meter is registered with the registry.
items.translation: 自定义器保证在将任何 Meter` 注册到注册表之前应用。

items.source: T - the registry type to customize
items.translation: T - 要自定义的注册表类型

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
